Name: Spooky Premium Farm Buildings
Author: MossiMods
Description:
[color=#00ff00][b]Installation instructions[/b][/color][color=#D4D4D8]
Unzip the file into your mods folder

In game, use the Paint Bucket Tool on your Premium Barn or Coop Exterior to choose one 
of these variants[/color]

[color=#00ff00][b]Main features[/b][/color][color=#D4D4D8]
4 Spooky Variations of both the Premium Barn and the Premium Coop[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]to match my Spooky Farmhouse 3 mod.  [/color]
[color=#ffd966][b]BONUS: [/b][/color][color=#D4D4D8]I also grabbed some sprites from other Stardew Valley Tilesheets [/color]
and put them in a png so you can edit / add them onto your buildings if you want :D 

[color=#00ff00][b]Requirements[/b][/color][color=#D4D4D8]
Alternative Textures
SMAPI[/color]
